description: Full EBSA civil-penalty enforcement history for one named plan sponsor/administrator, with every closed case and a count by case type. Matches the sponsor against both the plan administrator name and the plan name and reports which one hit. Use to answer whether an employer's benefit plans have a history of filing-compliance penalties.

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own free DOL Open Data Portal key (dataportal.dol.gov); omit it to use the platform key.

sponsor.description: Plan sponsor / administrator name, matched against the plan administrator and the plan name.
